analyst.summary: Lenskart is executing well operationally -- India same-store sales growth of ~24% and continued international expansion are real, volume-led progress, not accounting tricks. But the stock's valuation (a P/E variously cited between ~136x and ~277x across sources, all far above global peer EssilorLuxottica's ~50x) demands years of flawless execution, and the most recent quarter (Q4 FY26) actually saw profit fall year-on-year even as revenue grew over 40%, on the back of aggressive new-store costs. We are holding per the quant model's call, but flagging this as a valuation-vs-fundamentals tension worth the desk's attention rather than a comfortable Hold.
